en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

Kehehe... Well of course.
You are a boy, after all, Shuichi.

Such desires are appropriate for a 
human. I don't look down upon them.

But I have already given my heart to 
someone, so I cannot join you.

Anime and manga often use folklore 
and myth as a base for their stories.

This is perfect. Today I will teach 
you using these manga.

With this much literature before you, 
you claim you are bored...?

The wisest man is he who 
knows he knows nothing.

Perhaps it would serve you 
well to have more curiosity...

<CLT=cltMIND>Korekiyo is completely silent.
That's pretty rare...
